$comment: ADR 0049 §2. Where the first-run toolchain lives and which of its directories go on PATH. Read by desktop/toolchain (runtime) and generated into the NSIS script (installer), so both agree. Paths are relative to root. userPath is only what works from a bare terminal: git\cmd, python, llvm\bin. cargo\bin is agent-only (rustup's proxies need RUSTUP_HOME/CARGO_HOME, which only the app sets for its children); lsp\node_modules\.bin is agent-only (its shims need bun on PATH, and the app puts the bundled bun there for its children). git\usr\bin is on neither list: its link.exe is GNU coreutils' and would shadow MSVC's link.exe; Git's bash puts /usr/bin on its own PATH.
